submission.justification: Crystal-K3 gives the best 662 keV resolution of the three candidates at every thickness tested. A scan of K3 gave 3.32% (2 cm), 3.10% (3 cm), 2.80% (4 cm), 2.99% (5 cm), 3.00% (6 cm) and 3.88% (10 cm), so the optimum is near 4 cm. At 5 cm, K1 gave 4.38% and K2 gave 8.35%. The 2025 summary value of 2.9% at 5 cm is consistent with these results. The 20 cm Pb + 5 cm Cu shielding and radon purge are installed, and the DAQ (250 MS/s, 14-bit) needs no change for K3. The documents do not report K3's intrinsic radioactivity, so its suitability for low-background operation has not been verified; this should be checked with the vendor's radiopurity data before procurement.

requirements.requirement: Crystal must be one of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Crystal-K3 is one of the listed candidates and is available in the required size.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: K3 at 4 cm gave 2.80% FWHM, versus 4.38% for K1 and 8.35% for K2 at 5 cm. K3 was best across all thicknesses tested.
Recommended thickness is 4 cm, within 2-10 cm.

Shielding (20 cm Pb + 5 cm OFHC Cu) and radon purge are installed, and the DAQ needs no change. No project document reports intrinsic crystal radioactivity for any candidate, so K3's background performance has not been verified.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended crystal and thickness
requirements.evidence: This submission recommends Crystal-K3 at 4 cm.
